move.name: Move
move.description: Move eligible selected units to a destination.

attack.name: Attack
attack.description: Attack-move on ground, or force attack a visible damageable target, including friendlies.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Cancel orders and return to autonomous activity. Carried goods remain physical.

build.name: Build
build.description: Place a construction project on explored, clear ground.

produce.name: Produce
produce.description: Train a unit. Reserves its resources and supply immediately.

rally.name: Rally point
rally.description: Choose where newly produced units assemble.

pause.name: Pause production
pause.description: Finish committed work, then release staffing. Resume to request work again.

cancel.name: Cancel construction
cancel.description: Cancel this project and refund its reserved resources to an owned Mound with space.

cancelUpgrade.name: Cancel upgrade
cancelUpgrade.description: Cancel the upgrade and refund the full price.

cancelResearch.name: Cancel research
cancelResearch.description: Cancel this research and refund its full price.

hold.name: Hold Position
hold.description: Stand your ground. Attack enemies within weapon range without chasing.

patrol.name: Patrol
patrol.description: Patrol between the current position and a destination. Engage enemies, then resume patrol.

follow.name: Follow
follow.description: Follow a friendly unit. Right-click a friendly unit to follow it.

unload.name: Leave watchtower
unload.description: Release the archer at the tower entrance. A move order also leaves the lookout.

garrison.name: Enter watchtower
garrison.description: Walk to a friendly watchtower and occupy its single lookout.

category.hero.skills.name: New spell available
category.hero.skills.description: Spend a skill point to learn or improve an ability.

back.name: Back
back.description: Return to the previous command category.

camera.name: Cycle camera
camera.description: Follow the selected unit. Cycle RTS, third person and first person. Escape returns to RTS.

research.test.serrated-tools.name: Serrated Tools
research.test.serrated-tools.description: Workers extract wood twice as fast. Each tree still contains fifty Wood.

research.test.reinforced-carapace.name: Reinforced Carapace
research.test.reinforced-carapace.description: Warriors gain 150 maximum health and 2 armor. Existing wounds are preserved.

research.test.campaign-harness.name: Campaign Harness
research.test.campaign-harness.description: The Marshal gains 200 maximum health. Existing wounds are preserved; the improvement remains through death and revival.

research.test.driving-spear.name: Driving Spear
research.test.driving-spear.description: Hunters can charge every 4 seconds instead of 8. Requires a fresh approach; remaining in melee never triggers another charge.

research.test.saturating-shells.name: Saturating Shells
research.test.saturating-shells.description: Bombardier blast radius grows from 2 to 3 cells, and its two-second slow strengthens from 20% to 35%. Slows do not add together.

research.test.beetles-serrated-tools.name: Serrated Tools
research.test.beetles-serrated-tools.description: Workers extract wood twice as fast. Each tree still contains fifty Wood.

research.test.beetles-reinforced-carapac.name: Reinforced Carapace
research.test.beetles-reinforced-carapac.description: Horn Guards gain 150 maximum health and 2 armor. Existing wounds are preserved.

research.test.beetles-broadheads.name: Broadheads
research.test.beetles-broadheads.description: Stone Slingers deal 35% more attack damage.

research.test.beetles-campaign-harness.name: Campaign Harness
research.test.beetles-campaign-harness.description: The Hornbreaker gains 200 maximum health. Existing wounds are preserved; the improvement remains through death and revival.

alpha.name: Ants
alpha.description: Versatile colony with quick infantry and a broad combined-arms roster.

beta.name: Beetles
beta.description: Stout, expensive infantry and a relentless frontline champion. Economy follows the same rules as ants.

definitions.name: Worker
definitions.description: Gather resources and construct buildings. Trained at the main hall; uses 1 supply.

definitions.name: Warrior
definitions.description: Armored ant infantry. Protects the colony and fights at close range.

definitions.name: Queensguard
definitions.description: Elite armored protector. Shields nearby allies and braces behind a tower shield for additional armor at reduced speed.

definitions.name: Winglancer
definitions.description: Fast flying lancer. Crosses rough terrain and strikes ground targets with an ivory lance; vulnerable to ranged anti-air fire.

definitions.name: Rootweaver
definitions.description: Fragile root caster with a broad leaf fan. Entangles ground enemies and grows slowing briar patches to control the battlefield.

definitions.name: Thornblade
definitions.description: Agile paired-dagger infantry. Automatically rushes visible ground enemies; can disable autocast for controlled engagements.

definitions.name: Archer
definitions.description: Ranged support. Keep enemies at a distance and protect archers with infantry.

definitions.name: Silkwarden
definitions.description: Silk support caster. Launches silk shots and automatically ensnares enemies, rooting ground units and grounding flyers.

definitions.name: Nectarist
definitions.description: Restorative support. Automatically sends nectar to wounded allies and can cleanse harmful effects.

definitions.name: Amber Adept
definitions.description: Disruption caster. Seals enemy spellcasters and strips their temporary magical protection.

definitions.name: Banneret
definitions.description: Standard bearer. Rallies nearby allies for increased attack damage and defends itself with a baton.

definitions.name: Queensguard Hall
definitions.description: The colony main hall stores resources, trains workers and provides 15 supply.

definitions.name: Great Acorn Hall
definitions.description: The colony main hall stores resources, trains workers and provides 15 supply.

definitions.name: Elder Hall
definitions.description: Tier 3 Acorn Hall. Supports a roster of three distinct heroes.

definitions.name: Barracks
definitions.description: Trains the colony’s infantry and ranged troops.

definitions.name: Forester lodge
definitions.description: Decorative forest lodge. Ranked forests do not regrow.

definitions.name: Mound
definitions.description: A compact colony mound that provides 8 supply when completed.

definitions.name: Watchtower
definitions.description: A raised acorn lookout for one Archer. Right-click it with an Archer to enter; fire from the top using that unit’s own weapon and upgrades.

definitions.name: Wood
definitions.description: Ten wood per load, carried to a colony drop-off.

definitions.name: Amber
definitions.description: Precious forest resin mined from ancient roots and carried to the Mound.

definitions.name: Forest tree
definitions.description: Fifty wood, collected in ten-wood loads. Falls when depleted.

definitions.name: Ant Marshal
definitions.description: A seasoned colony champion armed with a heavy flanged mace. Gains experience from nearby enemy defeats.

definitions.name: Barkguard Charm
definitions.description: +2 armor.

definitions.name: Thornband
definitions.description: +6 attack damage.

definitions.name: Heartseed
definitions.description: +120 maximum health.

definitions.name: Resin Salve
definitions.description: Consume to restore 160 health.

definitions.name: Royal Crest
definitions.description: +10 damage, +3 armor and +100 maximum health.

definitions.name: Moon Dew
definitions.description: Restore 80 mana. Consumed on use.

definitions.name: Amber Node
definitions.description: One miner extracts ten amber at a time; other workers queue. Five nodes form a standard amber site.

definitions.name: Amber Sanctuary
definitions.description: Calls fallen heroes back to the colony, preserving their experience, abilities and inventory.

definitions.name: Trailkeeper’s Flask
definitions.description: 3 charges: restore 70 health and 25 mana. 10s cooldown between uses.

definitions.name: Ancient Heartwood
definitions.description: +280 maximum health and +2 health per second.

definitions.name: Moonwell Chalice
definitions.description: +140 maximum mana and +1.5 mana per second.

definitions.name: Predator’s Talon
definitions.description: +10 damage. Basic attacks restore 10% of damage dealt as health.

definitions.name: Amber Carapace
definitions.description: +4 armor. Activate: absorb 180 damage for up to 8s. 45s cooldown.

definitions.name: Broodkeeper’s Lantern
definitions.description: Aura: allied living units within 6 tiles regenerate 2 health per second.

definitions.name: Warcaller’s Standard
definitions.description: Aura: allied units within 6 tiles gain 10% attack damage.

definitions.name: Stormwing Spurs
definitions.description: +10% movement speed and +12% attack speed.

definitions.name: Rootbinder’s Idol
definitions.description: Activate: enemies within 4 tiles take 60 magic damage and are rooted for 2s (they can still attack). 35s cooldown.

definitions.name: Worldroot Heart
definitions.description: +450 maximum health and +4 health per second. Activate: restore 20% maximum health. 70s cooldown.

definitions.name: Tempest Antennae
definitions.description: +15% attack speed. Every third basic hit arcs 45 magic damage to up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles of the target.

definitions.name: Phoenix Chrysalis
definitions.description: +120 maximum health. Once: prevent a lethal hit, restore 35% health and become invulnerable for 1.5s. The chrysalis then breaks.

definitions.name: Scepter of the Deep Moon
definitions.description: +220 maximum mana, +2 mana per second and 20% shorter hero ability cooldowns. Does not affect items.

definitions.name: Banner of the Endless Brood
definitions.description: Aura: allied units within 7 tiles gain 15% attack speed. Activate: nearby allies ignore roots and stuns for 4s. 90s cooldown.

definitions.name: Hourglass of Amber
definitions.description: +100 maximum mana. Activate: reduce remaining hero ability cooldowns by 12s. Does not affect items. 100s cooldown.

definitions.name: Heart of Winter
definitions.description: +180 maximum health. Aura: enemies within 5 tiles move 15% slower. Activate: deal 120 magic damage within 5 tiles and slow attack speed by 20% for 4s. 60s cooldown.

definitions.name: Chitin Works
definitions.description: Researches permanent improvements for the colony. Existing and future units benefit from completed research.

definitions.name: Root
definitions.description: Fibrous heartwood from contested Corrupted Root deposits. Workers deliver it only to a Rootworks.

definitions.name: Corrupted Root
definitions.description: One miner extracts ten Root at a time; other workers queue. Deliver to a Rootworks.

definitions.name: Rootworks
definitions.description: Receives Root from nearby Corrupted Root deposits. Delivered Root becomes spendable colony currency. Does not accept Amber or Wood.

definitions.name: Hunter
definitions.description: Spear infantry that charges enemy units from 3–8 building cells away. A clear approach grants double speed and a double-damage first hit, once every 8 seconds.

definitions.name: Bombardier
definitions.description: Back-mounted mortar fires arcing shells that damage enemies in a two-cell radius and slow movement by 20% for two seconds. Shells can be dodged.

definitions.name: Bombardier Workshop
definitions.description: Equips free workers with Root-loaded mortars. Requires a Great Mound; each Bombardier consumes Amber, Wood, Root and one worker.

definitions.name: Webling
definitions.description: Hungry Weblings · melee forest creature. A webbed hollow with rushing spiders and a silk-spitting defender.

definitions.name: Spitter
definitions.description: Hungry Weblings · ranged forest creature. A webbed hollow with rushing spiders and a silk-spitting defender.

definitions.name: Rootling
definitions.description: Rootbound Guardians · melee forest creature. Ancient roots defending an overgrown grove.

definitions.name: Twigcaster
definitions.description: Rootbound Guardians · ranged forest creature. Ancient roots defending an overgrown grove.

definitions.name: Needle Wasp
definitions.description: Hornet Raiders · ranged forest creature. Wild hornets patrolling a paper nest.

definitions.name: Hollow Stag
definitions.description: The Hollow Stag · melee forest creature. A sacred forest guardian and its bark-and-willow retinue.

definitions.name: Barkguard
definitions.description: The Hollow Stag · melee forest creature. A sacred forest guardian and its bark-and-willow retinue.

definitions.name: Root Seer
definitions.description: The Rotwood Court · ranged forest creature. A corrupted ancient surrounded by rootbeasts and violet spores.

definitions.name: Worker
definitions.description: Gather resources and construct beetle buildings. Same gathering, movement and training rules as ant workers.

definitions.name: Horn Guard
definitions.description: Durable heavy infantry. Slower and more expensive than ant Warriors; uses 1 supply.

definitions.name: Stone Slinger
definitions.description: Heavy thrown stones strike ground and flying enemies. Shorter reach than ant Archers; uses 1 supply.

definitions.name: Hornbreaker
definitions.description: Beetle champion. Charges into battle, overwhelms a chosen enemy, sustains nearby allies and becomes a Colossus.

definitions.name: Bastion
definitions.description: The beetle colony’s iron-clad main hall stores resources, trains workers and provides supply.

definitions.name: Great Bastion
definitions.description: Great Bastion of the beetle colony. Model pending.

definitions.name: Elder Bastion
definitions.description: Elder Bastion of the beetle colony. Model pending.

definitions.name: Brood Den
definitions.description: An iron-banded shell nursery that provides eight supply for the beetle colony.

definitions.name: War Lodge
definitions.description: Iron-clad training hall for the beetle colony’s infantry and ranged troops.

definitions.name: Shell Forge
definitions.description: Forges stronger weapons and armor for the beetle colony. Completed research benefits existing and future units.

definitions.name: Ancestor Shrine
definitions.description: Ancestor Shrine of the beetle colony. Model pending.

definitions.name: Rootworks
definitions.description: Rootworks of the beetle colony. Model pending.

definitions.name: Hornwatch
definitions.description: Hornwatch of the beetle colony. Model pending.

definitions.name: Rootbreaker
definitions.description: A towering ant bruiser with a massive root club. Weakens enemy armor, crushes individual foes, draws attacks with his roar, and erupts roots across the battlefield.

definitions.name: Briar Cutthroat
definitions.description: Briarwatch campaign character.

definitions.name: Bark Cottage
definitions.description: Briarwatch settlement.

definitions.name: Resin Poultice Bundle
definitions.description: Restore 150 health to nearby allies.

definitions.name: Seed of Vigor
definitions.description: Pick up to permanently gain 25 maximum health and 1 attack damage. Does not occupy an inventory slot.

definitions.name: Ruined Cottage
definitions.description: The broken remains of a raided home.

definitions.name: Feral Spirit
definitions.description: A temporary, controllable forest spirit summoned by magic.

definitions.name: Lesser Shadow Spirit
definitions.description: A temporary forest spirit raised by a cursed enemy’s death.

definitions.name: Shadow Spirit
definitions.description: A temporary forest spirit raised by a cursed enemy’s death.

definitions.name: Greater Shadow Spirit
definitions.description: A temporary forest spirit raised by a cursed enemy’s death.

definitions.name: Grove Nursery
definitions.description: An immobile summoned nursery. Its producing status is granted by the spell, with no built-in spell behavior.

definitions.name: Earth Spirit
definitions.description: A linked, controllable spirit body. Its retained caster returns through surviving bodies in Earth, Storm, Fire order.

definitions.name: Storm Spirit
definitions.description: A linked, controllable spirit body. Its retained caster returns through surviving bodies in Earth, Storm, Fire order.

definitions.name: Fire Spirit
definitions.description: A linked, controllable spirit body. Its retained caster returns through surviving bodies in Earth, Storm, Fire order.
